prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence remains thin for 7 kinds of change with only 1 test; rules are only stated when at least 2 tests agree.
'home, wait_info' and 'finish, new_screen' are helpful, supported by multiple winning tests (3 of 6 and 2 of 4 won, respectively).
'adoption, redesign' and 'sign_in, redesign' consistently hurt performance across tests.
No clear effect was seen for 'adoption, layout', 'adoption, notification', 'choose_path, layout', 'sign_in, hint', and 'sign_in, incentive', as all tests yielded no clear effect.
Results for 'choose_path, copy' and 'choose_path, hint' remain inconsistent across tests.
Predictions were often overly optimistic for unhelpful changes and underpredicted gains on unexpected winning tests.

Changes:
0: [home, wait_info] Desktop Renderer Launch Status Counter: Display a real-time status counter for desktop rendering engine setup on the waiting screen so users know the app is actively loading. (why: Home step has a high mean waiting time (2336s) and support receives complaints about pets not showing or app stalling.)
1: [finish, new_screen] Interactive Desktop Pet Voice and Command Cheat Sheet Screen: Add a dedicated end-of-onboarding screen explaining how to summon, move, and talk to your desktop pet. (why: Multiple support emails mention post-onboarding confusion regarding how to control, hide, or talk to the pet.)
2: [home, wait_info] Desktop Display Mode Compatibility Wait Card: Show a display mode setup card on the waiting screen explaining background rendering checks. (why: Home screen mean load time is high (2336s) and users complain about pet visibility issues on desktop.)
3: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Companion Quick Command Overview Screen: Introduce a final onboarding screen highlighting key shortcuts and desktop interaction gestures. (why: Post-onboarding support emails show users are unclear on how to hide or talk to the pet.)
4: [choose_path, new_flow] Guided Pet Companion Goal Selection Flow: Introduce an interactive goal selection step where users pick their primary use case before choosing a pet path. (why: Mean time on path selection is high (514s), indicating users are uncertain which path suits their goals.)
5: [sign_in, reorder] Post Adoption Certificate Account Sign In Reorder: Reorder sign-in step to occur immediately after adoption certificate confirmation. (why: Adoption drops to 60.9% and users report missing pets after signing in again; securing account after naming pet connects account creation with pet ownership.)
6: [adoption, new_flow] Interactive Pet Personality Trait Selector Flow: Add a dedicated pet trait selection sub-flow during friend selection to customize pet behavior upfront. (why: Adoption has low conversion (60.9%) and long median time (89s), showing users want more meaningful customization options.)
7: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Docking & Placement Tutorial Screen: Add a post-adoption visual tutorial screen demonstrating how the pet sits on taskbars and multi-monitor setups. (why: Multiple support tickets report pets not appearing on desktop or misbehaving desktop features after setup.)
8: [choose_path, hint] Story Scroll Desktop Companion Highlight Hint: Add an overlay hint on the story screen highlighting how desktop pets run unobtrusively in the background. (why: Median time on story/choose_path is quick but mean is high (514s), showing some users hesitate before starting path choice.)
